name: 2x2 Trade-off Grids
deliverable: Flexible comparative evaluation across two arbitrary orthogonal axes

steps.text: Name the two axes driving the deadlock, then check that one does not simply imply the other.
Label both ends of each axis in plain language and post the labels where the whole room can see them.
Place each candidate by arguing its position on one axis, then the other, against cards already placed.
Rename the quadrants for this decision and say what action each quadrant authorizes.
Choose at least one high-risk, high-value candidate and name the experiment that would de-risk it.

failure: Correlated axes flatten the grid into a diagonal, every candidate looks alike, and the session produces no decision.
intervention: Test whether high on one axis forces high on the other. If it does, replace one axis with a pressure that truly conflicts.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in strategy and design practice; no single documented originator.
